title: Product Packshot Photos for Multiple Views | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one photo per side into clean packshots of the front, back, top and base. AI multi-angle product photos for galleries and paid social ads.
h1: Product Packshot Photos for Multiple Views of Your Item
lead: One front photo leaves questions about ports, buttons and the back. Build a coordinated packshot set that shows each real side.

steps.d: Provide one photo for each side, with the whole item in frame. Real views keep ports, handles and corners accurate.
Name the view and one clean backdrop, then reuse it for every side. You get square packshots sharing one setting.
Download each view, compare controls with your source photos, then place them after the hero image. No studio needed.

faq.q: Should I photograph each side separately?
faq.a: Yes. Separate front, back, base and detail photos keep ports, controls, labels and closures tied to the real surface.

faq.q: Can one photo reveal a hidden port?
faq.a: Not reliably. A real photo of that side is the source for an accurate packshot.
Put the front first, then add side views that answer questions about controls, connectors, closures or other details.

faq.q: What file formats work for source photos?
faq.a: JPG, PNG or WebP files that show the whole product clearly work for the source set.

faq.q: How many angle photos do I need?
faq.a: Three or four views cover many listings: a front, back and one or two detail angles. Add a base or control view when it answers a common question.

faq.q: How many credits does each angle photo cost?
faq.a: Each generated angle photo costs 24 credits, and the cost appears before you run it.

faq.q: Can one front photo generate sides I did not photograph?
faq.a: Not reliably. A real photo of each side keeps hidden ports and details from becoming guessed views.

faq.q: Can I run multi-angle images as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos can be used in listings and your own paid campaigns with no watermark.
